Definition: a Libnite or descendants of Libni (collectively)
BiblicalUsage: Libnîy means a Libnite or descendants of Libni. In Numbers 3:21, "Of Gershon [was] the family of the Libnites"; and in Numbers 26:58, "These [are] the families of the Levites: the family of the Libnites".
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the Libnites are named in their families because God counts His servants by name — the sons of Gershon, the families of the Levites.
Sources: Strong's Exhaustive Concordance (1890), via OpenScriptures Strong's Dictionary (CC BY-SA)
